copy.headline: Senate And House Lawmakers Added As Cosponsors To New Federal Film & TV Incentive Legislation
copy.caption: UPDATED: More than 60 House members and four Senators have signed on to legislation to establish a 20% federal film incentive, amid an effort to see passage during the lame duck session of Congress.

story.title: Senate And House Lawmakers Added As Cosponsors To New Federal Film & TV Incentive Legislation
